- The ability to generate reports on group bookings, track performance, and analyze data.

7. Integration with other systems
- The ability to integrate with other systems such as CRM, ERP, or other booking systems.

- Ensuring that the group booking manager is secure and that user data is protected.

When the process is needed again, it is swapped back into main memory.

Swapping is a key part of virtual memory management and allows systems to run more processes than the available physical memory would otherwise allow.
